body: import { Meta, Links, Scripts, ScrollRestoration } from 'react-router'
import Meta / Links / Scripts.description: The document components rendered by `root.tsx` in Framework mode.

Meta.description:
Renders the tags returned by every matched route's `meta` export. Goes in `<head>`.
Without it, route-level `meta` has no effect.

Links.description: Renders the `<link>` tags from every matched route's `links` export. Goes in `<head>`.

Scripts.description: Renders the client bundle's script tags. Omit it for a JS-free document — forms and links still work through full page loads.

import PrefetchPageLinks.description: Prefetch another route's assets and data.

PrefetchPageLinks.description:
Eagerly fetches the modules and loader data for a page.
For prefetching a route no link points at yet; `<Link prefetch>` covers the common case.
